info.title: MCP-RI Backend API
info.summary: Versioned API for bounded learner research artifacts and durable trajectory records.
info.description: Research snapshots are served read-only. Trajectory records are application-authored and durable. Behavioral summaries, cognitive estimates, and representation plans retain their source limitations.
